name: Mauro Mueller
bio: Mauro Mueller is a Mexican-Swiss filmmaker. He received his MFA in directing from Columbia University. His short film 'A World for Raúl' won a Student Oscar® and he is a member of the Academy (AMPAS). His projects have received the support of Tribeca, IFP, IMCINE and Sundance.  'Dear Chicken's, starring Philip Baker Hall, was a contender for the Oscars 2019. Mauro was a 2nd unit director of Gina Rodriguez’ sci-fi film 'Awake' and produced five features including the award winning 'Copenhagen' and 'Cosmic Dawn'.
